newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products lifted by strong futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products lifted by strong futures.

text.p: NWE oil products took support from firmer futures to gain ground on Thursday, traders said.
Naphtha ended modestly higher on the back of crude's gains, heavy swaps buying and talk that some cargoes in the Med may still go to the U.S., instead of to NWE.
Gasoline barges ended $1-$2 higher in thin trade.
High sulphur fuel oil was slightly firmer. But ARA inventories are high, and more transatlantic barrels are arriving next week.
Gas oil barges were $6-7 higher on the back of very strong IPE futures. Premiums held broadly steady arond Feb IPE +$2-3.
